fee_notes: Base fee is $49,900 for a territory with population between 175,000 and 200,000. An additional $500 is charged per 1,000 people (or part thereof) over 200,000, making the high end open-ended based on territory population. A 10% discount is available to qualifying veterans (VetFran Program) and to existing franchisees purchasing an additional franchise within 24 months of their first purchase. Only one discount may be applied per franchise purchase. A non-refundable $5,000 deposit (or $10,000 for a second territory) is required to reserve a territory and is applied toward the franchise fee. A "Winners' Circle" rebate program allows franchisees to recoup up to the full franchise fee in increments upon achieving cumulative gross revenue milestones over five years.
raw_excerpt: The franchise fee for a territory with a population between 175,000 and 200,000 is $ 49,900. If the population of your territory exceeds 200,000, you must pay an additional $500 for all or part of every 1,000 people over 200,000. ... Except for the discounts described above, the minimum franchise fee is $ 49,900.
